description: This file defines the SupervisorUserRole class, which extends AbstractUserRole within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It manages access control for supervisors, including retrieving accessible employee IDs, location IDs, and performance review IDs based on permissions and relationships. It also provides quick launch features relevant to supervisor roles.

classes.name: SupervisorUserRole
classes.description: A class managing supervisor user roles, providing access control logic for employees, locations, and performance reviews within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LocationService instance used for location-related operations.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Determines accessible entity IDs based on entity type (Employee, Location, PerformanceReview) for the supervisor.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of employees subordinate to the supervisor.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationIds
methods.description: Retrieves location IDs associated with subordinate employees.

methods.name: getAccessibleReviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves performance review IDs where the supervisor is a reviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Provides a list of quick launch options available to the supervisor role.
